notes.title: 2023.11.13 Update Notes
notes.content:
Goal for achieving Marksman League achievements reduced from 15 to 10
Maps now have new boss indicators
The number of difficulties has now been reduced from 7 to 6, and all difficulties will be opened after clearing the difficulty, and the difficulty level of each level will be adjusted accordingly
The number of objective levels per week has been reduced from 8 to 7
Added defense mode and active attack mode, and adjusted the mode switch function to the right mouse button
The queue panel is now adjusted to Esc key for outgoing calls

Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue where the Holy Maiden's skills were abnormal for a period of time after entering a new scene

notes.title: 11.2 Game Balance Adjustments
notes.content:
After receiving a large number of player feedback, due to the design mistakes of the production team, the cost of death in the early stage of the game is too high, and the following adjustments are now made to the game content:
Added a new Money Bag in the town to increase the amount of gold below 1000 to 1000.
Added food bags to towns to provide players with an additional 300 food.

We are sorry for the trouble, and we will continue to pay attention to the follow-up, and hope that you will give positive feedback to help us achieve better game quality, thank you for your understanding and support.

A new adjustment has been added:
Gourmet's food consumption reduction increased from 5% to 10%.
